card.title: 1er HUSSARDS
card.text: At the end of your turn, draw a card if the enemy has no units on the battlefield.
card.flavorText: The 1st Hussar Regiment was a cavalry unit of the French Army during WWII. It was established in 1791, during the Revolution, from a previous royal cavalry regiment dating back to 1719. The name Hussar comes from their function and uniform, both similar to Hungarian Huszárs which are units of light cavalry. In May 1940, as part of the 1st Light Cavalry Division, it was tasked with delaying the German advance in the Belgian Ardennes, and covering the following retreat of the Allied troops. During the Battle of Stonne (15-27 May 1940), 400 hussars of the 1st Regiment defended the village of Mont-Dieu and held back 5 German battalions for 3 days. They managed to withdraw safely, however the Wehrmacht launched an offensive on Tannay on May 23rd, defeated the 1st Hussar and captured the village. The regiment lost 190 men, killed, wounded or MIA, during the Battle of France. It was disbanded after the Armistice of June 22nd 1940, and refounded later by the Resistance in 1945, under the name Reconnaissance Regiment of the 25th Division. In 1946 it evolved into a paratrooper unit, still active to this day, named 1st Parachute Hussar Regiment.
